items.question: Which additional named figures are included in the ongoing enumerated sequence?
premises: Sanātana is added to the enumeration.
Sanatkumāra is added to the enumeration.
Their inclusion follows in the same manner as the preceding figures.
items.inference: The enumerated sequence continues by including Sanātana and Sanatkumāra as further members.
uncertainties: The specific role of Sanātana and Sanatkumāra in this context (deities, gurus, or other figures) is not determined from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And also Sanātana, and Sanatkumāra likewise, and [others follow].
